Athlete torso faces ALONG THE LENGTH of a single straight horizontal overhead bar (not facing across it as ordinary wide pull-up). Bar runs diagonally from front-left toward rear-right in camera threequarter perspective. Athlete is viewed SIDE-THREEQUARTER so one hand is IN FRONT of the other along bar, TWO close-grip HANDS CLEARLY SEPARATE by15cm with visible empty bar shaft BETWEEN the hands. Front hand grasps UNDERHAND, supinated palm surface toward athletes face. Rear hand grasps OVERHAND, pronated knuckles visible and palm away from face. Knees slightly bent, both FEET AIRBORNE with clear white gap above floor. Show full body and two-post rack supporting straight overhead bar, including stable feet of rack, sensible bar joints, no extra floating bars.
